guarantees.claim: key_init[0][i] and key_init[1][i] are continuously driven by reg2hw.key_share0[i].q and reg2hw.key_share1[i].q respectively; key_init_qe[0][i] and key_init_qe[1][i] by the corresponding .qe qualifiers, for all i in 0..NumRegsKey-1.

assumptions.claim: reg2hw.key_share0 and key_share1 are written with the correct AES key material (both shares) before key expansion is triggered.
assumptions.risk: use of an incorrect, zero, or uninitialized key compromises AES encryption integrity.

assumptions.claim: reg2hw.key_share0[i].qe and key_share1[i].qe are asserted exactly when the corresponding key word is updated, to enable capture into the key expansion logic.
assumptions.risk: missing or spurious .qe pulses cause the key expansion to use stale, incomplete, or double-captured data.

uncertain_points.claim: If not all NumRegsKey registers are written before the key expansion starts, uninitialized portions of key_init (from reset or previous values) could propagate, resulting in a weak or corrupted key.
uncertain_points.cond: NumRegsKey > 1; key expansion is triggered before all key_share registers have been written
uncertain_points.risk: AES operations run with a partially unknown key, defeating confidentiality/integrity.
